cases.prompt: Simulate QPSK over AWGN from Es/N0 = 0 to 10 dB in 2 dB steps
cases.expected_snr_convention: Es/N0 (convertible to Eb/N0: Eb/N0 = Es/N0 - 3.0103 dB)
